messages:
noah (eng-ml): quick scorecard from smoke runs on aspen15b-2026-02. ran fp16 / int8 / int6 over sampled traffic (~3.5k requests). short recs below.
reema (ml): drop numbers pls.
noah (eng-ml): paste: 
```
model: aspen15b-2026-02
configs: fp16, int8, int6
latency p50/p95 (ms): fp16 58/145, int8 61/155, int6 66/190
throughput tokens/sec: fp16 160, int8 175, int6 205
quality (rouge-L / EM on eval): fp16 54.2 / 88.1, int8 53.9 / 87.8, int6 52.8 / 86.9
token cost est: fp16 $0.0026, int8 $0.0017, int6 $0.0011
notes: int6 gives ~35% cost vs int8 but p95 tail worsens; quality gap most pronounced on long-context summarization and multi-turn code edits.
```
ash (prod): any >1.5 EM drops on slices?
noah (eng-ml): longform summarization (>3k tokens) sees ~1.6 EM drop int6 vs int8; code-edit slice ~2.3 EM drop. chat and short Q/A within 0.4 EM.
reema (ml): recommendation: make int6 default only for low-risk chat/assistant routes. keep int8 as our "standard" default for new GTN tenants; reserve fp16 for regulated/high-fidelity routes.
vic (gtn): product ask: can we do per-route defaults + canary?
noah (eng-ml): yes. proposed rollout: canary 48h at 20% traffic, probes every 5m (200 chat, 75 longform, 40 code-edit), auto-fallback rules: if probe EM drops >1.0 sustained 20m or p95 latency increases >35% -> fallback to int8/fp16 per route.
canary-bot: canary created id=cb-998, start=2026-05-02T22:00:00Z, traffic=20%, fallback=int8, alert=#eng-ml-ops
ash (prod): require product advisory: "Default mapping: standard=int8, econ=int6 opt-in, fidelity=fp16." also add explicit opt-in checkbox for eco.
reema (ml): I'll own probes and dashboard; will post 24h snapshot.
noah (eng-ml): ok launch canary. will file rollout checklist and link to onboarding doc. closing thread.
